## Code-Review and Validation Mechanisms — `qemu-project/qemu` @ `300438f`

---

### 1. Repository-Wide Mechanisms

#### 1.1 Patch Submission Pipeline (Email-Based, Not PR-Based)

QEMU does **not** use GitHub or GitLab merge requests as the primary review channel. The canonical workflow is:

- Patches are sent to [`qemu-devel@nongnu.org`](https://lists.gnu.org/mailman/listinfo/qemu-devel) via `git send-email`, `git-publish`, or `b4`.
- GitHub is explicitly a **read-only mirror**; the [`.github/workflows/lockdown.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/qemu-project-qemu@300438ffbb8d9430cac2fcc15cba6f482b2c0587/-/blob/.github/workflows/lockdown.yml) workflow auto-closes and locks any GitHub PRs with a redirect to the GitLab/mailing-list workflow.
- Patchew (`patchew.org`) is used as an external patch tracking system. Its configuration is archived in [`.patchew.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/qemu-project-qemu@300438ffbb8d9430cac2fcc15cba6f482b2c0587/-/blob/.patchew.yml) (marked explicitly as unused for runtime, serving only as documentation).

**Deterministic verification query:** Search for `"pull_request"` in `.github/workflows/lockdown.yml` — observe it is bound to `pull_request_target: opened` only for the purpose of locking/closing the PR.

---

#### 1.2 Developer Certificate of Origin (DCO) — Hard Gate

Every commit must carry a `Signed-off-by: NAME <EMAIL>` tag. This is enforced by:

- [`check-dco`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/qemu-project-qemu@300438ffbb8d9430cac2fcc15cba6f482b2c0587/-/blob/.gitlab-ci.d/static_checks.yml?L15-25) — a **blocking** GitLab CI job (no `allow_failure: true`) that runs [`.gitlab-ci.d/check-dco.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/qemu-project-qemu@300438ffbb8d9430cac2fcc15cba6f482b2c0587/-/blob/.gitlab-ci.d/check-dco.py).
- The script walks all commits since `merge-base` with `master`, checks for presence of `Signed-off-by:`, and additionally rejects tags where the email domain is `localhost`.
- Exits non-zero on any violation; the CI job does not set `allow_failure`.

**Deterministic verification query:** In [`.gitlab-ci.d/static_checks.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/qemu-project-qemu@300438ffbb8d9430cac2fcc15cba6f482b2c0587/-/blob/.gitlab-ci.d/static_checks.yml), the `check-dco` job has no `allow_failure` key (contrast with `check-patch` at line 13 which does). Confirmed at lines 15–25.

---

#### 1.3 Coding-Style Linting (`checkpatch.pl`) — Non-Blocking Gate

- [`check-patch`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/qemu-project-qemu@300438ffbb8d9430cac2fcc15cba6f482b2c0587/-/blob/.gitlab-ci.d/static_checks.yml?L1-13) runs [`scripts/checkpatch.pl`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/qemu-project-qemu@300438ffbb8d9430cac2fcc15cba6f482b2c0587/-/blob/scripts/checkpatch.pl) across all commits in the branch relative to `master`, via [`.gitlab-ci.d/check-patch.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/qemu-project-qemu@300438ffbb8d9430cac2fcc15cba6f482b2c0587/-/blob/.gitlab-ci.d/check-patch.py).
- `checkpatch.pl` is the Linux kernel-derived style checker adapted for QEMU; version `0.31` at this revision.
- This job sets `allow_failure: true` — style failures are visible but non-blocking.
- The job is tagged `QEMU_JOB_ONLY_FORKS: 1`, meaning it runs in **contributor forks** only, not upstream staging branches.
- Patchew also runs `checkpatch` independently (`.patchew.yml` lines 134–141): `scripts/checkpatch.pl --mailback base..`, emailing results back to the submitter.
- Local pre-send checks are also configured in [`.b4-config`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/qemu-project-qemu@300438ffbb8d9430cac2fcc15cba6f482b2c0587/-/blob/.b4-config): `am-perpatch-check-cmd = scripts/checkpatch.pl -q --terse --no-summary --mailback -` and identically for `prep-perpatch-check-cmd`.

**Deterministic verification query:** Grep `.gitlab-ci.d/static_checks.yml` for `allow_failure` — `check-patch` at line 13 has it; `check-dco` (lines 15–25) does not.

#### 1.4 Ownership — `MAINTAINERS` File and `get_maintainer.pl`

- [`MAINTAINERS`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/qemu-project-qemu@300438ffbb8d9430cac2fcc15cba6f482b2c0587/-/blob/MAINTAINERS) maps subsystems to `M:` (maintainer, must be CC'd), `R:` (reviewer, should be CC'd), `L:` (mailing list), `S:` (status), and `F:`/`X:` (file globs).

This is referenced directly from `b4`'s `send-auto-cc-cmd` in `.b4-config` and from `git publish`.
- [`scripts/gitlab-map-check`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/qemu-project-qemu@300438ffbb8d9430cac2fcc15cba6f482b2c0587/-/blob/scripts/gitlab-map-check) and the auto-generated [`.gitlab-map-auto`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/qemu-project-qemu@300438ffbb8d9430cac2fcc15cba6f482b2c0587/-/blob/.gitlab-map-auto) map maintainer real names (from `MAINTAINERS`) to GitLab account handles for issue/MR assignment. The map is regenerated by `scripts/gitlab-map-update`.

#### 1.5 Build and Test Matrix (GitLab CI)

The CI pipeline is defined in [`.gitlab-ci.d/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/qemu-project-qemu@300438ffbb8d9430cac2fcc15cba6f482b2c0587/-/tree/.gitlab-ci.d) and included from [`.gitlab-ci.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/qemu-project-qemu@300438ffbb8d9430cac2fcc15cba6f482b2c0587/-/blob/.gitlab-ci.yml) (which itself is a single-line include pointing to `qemu-project.yml`).

**Stages:** [`containers` → `build` → `test`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/qemu-project-qemu@300438ffbb8d9430cac2fcc15cba6f482b2c0587/-/blob/.gitlab-ci.d/stages.yml).

Key structural rules from [`.gitlab-ci.d/base.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/qemu-project-qemu@300438ffbb8d9430cac2fcc15cba6f482b2c0587/-/blob/.gitlab-ci.d/base.yml):
- Jobs **never** run automatically upstream on `stable-*` branches or tags (staging branches are used as pre-merge gates).
- Forks must opt-in by setting `QEMU_CI=1` (manual) or `QEMU_CI=2` (automatic).
- All native build jobs use `--enable-werror` (compiler warnings are build errors).
- `meson-logs/*.junit.xml` is collected as a JUnit test report artifact.

**Native build matrix** ([`buildtest.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/qemu-project-qemu@300438ffbb8d9430cac2fcc15cba6f482b2c0587/-/blob/.gitlab-ci.d/buildtest.yml)) includes at minimum: Alpine, Ubuntu 24.04, Debian. **Cross-compilation builds** ([`crossbuilds.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/qemu-project-qemu@300438ffbb8d9430cac2fcc15cba6f482b2c0587/-/blob/.gitlab-ci.d/crossbuilds.yml)): arm64, ppc64el, riscv64, and others.

**Test targets invoked per job:**
- `check-unit` — unit tests
- `check-qtest` — QTest (device/integration tests via QEMU process)
- `check-functional` — functional tests (boots actual guest kernels)
- `check` — all of the above combined
- `check-build` — build-only, no test run (used in some jobs)

**Deterministic verification query:** In [`.gitlab-ci.d/buildtest-template.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/qemu-project-qemu@300438ffbb8d9430cac2fcc15cba6f482b2c0587/-/blob/.gitlab-ci.d/buildtest-template.yml?L12), confirm `--enable-werror` is passed unconditionally to `configure`.

---

#### 1.6 Rust-Specific Checks

A dedicated [`check-rust-tools-nightly`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/qemu-project-qemu@300438ffbb8d9430cac2fcc15cba6f482b2c0587/-/blob/.gitlab-ci.d/static_checks.yml?L50-68) job runs:
1. `cargo fmt --check` — format conformance.
2. `make clippy` — Rust linting.
3. `make rustdoc` — documentation build.

Clippy configuration is at [`clippy.toml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/qemu-project-qemu@300438ffbb8d9430cac2fcc15cba6f482b2c0587/-/blob/clippy.toml): MSRV is `1.83.0`; `allow-mixed-uninlined-format-args = false`; `doc-valid-idents` has project-specific overrides.

This job sets `allow_failure: true` (depends on `fedora-rust-nightly`, an unstable image).

**Deterministic verification query:** `clippy.toml` line 3: `msrv = "1.83.0"` is the pinned minimum Rust version for linting purposes.

---

#### 1.7 Python Tooling Checks

Two jobs in [`static_checks.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/qemu-project-qemu@300438ffbb8d9430cac2fcc15cba6f482b2c0587/-/blob/.gitlab-ci.d/static_checks.yml?L26-49):
- `check-python-minreqs` — runs `make -C python check-minreqs` to verify minimum dependency compatibility.
- `check-python-tox` — runs `make -C python check-tox`; marked `QEMU_JOB_OPTIONAL: 1` (manual trigger in upstream, optional in forks).

---

#### 1.8 Compilation Unit Analysis

[`check-build-units`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/qemu-project-qemu@300438ffbb8d9430cac2fcc15cba6f482b2c0587/-/blob/.gitlab-ci.d/static_checks.yml?L74-95) runs [`.gitlab-ci.d/check-units.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/qemu-project-qemu@300438ffbb8d9430cac2fcc15cba6f482b2c0587/-/blob/.gitlab-ci.d/check-units.py) against `build/compile_commands.json` after a `configure` run. This reports total source file count, total build units, and the top 20 most-rebuilt files. This is an **informational/diagnostic** job (no enforced failure threshold).

---

#### 1.9 Coccinelle Semantic Patches

[`scripts/coccinelle/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/qemu-project-qemu@300438ffbb8d9430cac2fcc15cba6f482b2c0587/-/tree/scripts/coccinelle) contains 25 `.cocci` files for automated semantic analysis and refactoring, covering patterns such as:
- `errp-guard.cocci` — error pointer usage
- `error-use-after-free.cocci` — use-after-free in error paths
- `use-g_new-etc.cocci` — memory allocation idioms
- `timer-del-timer-free.cocci` — timer lifetime
- `overflow_muldiv64.cocci` — arithmetic overflow

These are not wired into a required CI job at this revision but serve as reviewer and developer tooling for tree-wide audits.

**Deterministic verification query:** `ls scripts/coccinelle/*.cocci | wc -l` in checkout → 25.

---

#### 1.10 `git blame` Ignore Revs

[`.git-blame-ignore-revs`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/qemu-project-qemu@300438ffbb8d9430cac2fcc15cba6f482b2c0587/-/blob/.git-blame-ignore-revs) lists 4 commits that were wholesale formatting/style cleanups:

| Commit | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `ad9e4585b3c7` | gdbstub: clean-up indents |
| `0eadd56bf53a` | e1000e: fix code style |
| `8c7feddddd92` | target/riscv: coding style fixes |
| `48805df9c22a` | replace TABs with spaces |

These are style-only commits submitted as dedicated patches (consistent with the documented policy to separate style from semantic changes).

**Deterministic verification query:** `git log --oneline ad9e4585b3c7` and `git log --oneline 48805df9c22a` to confirm these are separate commits and not mixed with functional changes.

---

#### 1.11 Commit Message Conventions (Documented Policy)

From [`docs/devel/submitting-a-patch.rst`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/qemu-project-qemu@300438ffbb8d9430cac2fcc15cba6f482b2c0587/-/blob/docs/devel/submitting-a-patch.rst):
- **Format:** `subsystem: single line summary`; body max 76 chars/line.
- **`Fixes:` tag** (with `<12-digit SHA> ("subject")`) required when a commit corrects a prior commit in the repository.
- **`Resolves:` tag** for GitLab issue URLs (triggers automatic issue close on merge).
- **`Buglink:` tag** for external bug tracker references.
- **`Cc: qemu-stable@nongnu.org`** signals backport candidacy to stable branches.
- Other recognized tags: `Tested-by:`, `Acked-by:`, `Reported-by:`, `Suggested-by:`, `Message-Id:`.
- Each commit must be bisect-safe (compile and run successfully in isolation).

---

#### 1.12 Stable Branch / Backport Policy

- Release branches are named `stable-X.Y`; CI never runs jobs on these automatically upstream (see base.yml line 44).
- Backports flow: fix merged to `master` first, then cherry-picked to stable. Bug fixes for severe regressions should carry `Cc: qemu-stable@nongnu.org` to notify stable maintainers.
- Patchew integration points to `https://patchew.org/QEMU/` for per-patch status tracking.

---

#### 1.13 Test Directory Structure

[`tests/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/qemu-project-qemu@300438ffbb8d9430cac2fcc15cba6f482b2c0587/-/tree/tests) is subdivided by test class:

| Directory | Purpose |
|-----------|---------|
| `tests/unit/` | Unit tests (C, fast, no QEMU process) |
| `tests/qtest/` | QTest — black-box device tests via QEMU process |
| `tests/functional/` | Functional tests — full guest boot scenarios |
| `tests/qapi-schema/` | Generated QAPI code output tests |
| `tests/tcg/` | TCG instruction translation tests |
| `tests/fp/` | Floating-point correctness tests |
| `tests/migration-stress/` | Migration-specific stress tests |
| `tests/docker/` | Docker-based build environment configs |
| `tests/lcitool/` | CI container build tooling |

QAPI generated file outputs are explicitly listed and verified in [`tests/meson.build`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/qemu-project-qemu@300438ffbb8d9430cac2fcc15cba6f482b2c0587/-/blob/tests/meson.build?L4-33) as a `custom_target`, ensuring generated code drifts are caught by build failures.

---

### 2. Summary of Gate Strictness

| Mechanism | Blocking? | Scope |
|---|---|---|
| `check-dco` (Signed-off-by) | **Yes** (hard fail) | All branches in forks and upstream staging |
| `check-patch` (checkpatch.pl) | No (`allow_failure: true`) | Fork branches only |
| `check-rust-tools-nightly` | No (`allow_failure: true`) | All |
| `check-python-minreqs` | **Yes** | All |
| `check-python-tox` | No (manual/optional) | All |
| `check-build-units` | No (informational) | All |
| Native build (`--enable-werror`) | **Yes** (compiler warnings are errors) | All build jobs |
| JUnit test reports | Collected always (`when: always`) | All meson test jobs |
| GitHub PRs | Immediately closed+locked | GitHub mirror |

---

### 3. Deterministic Verification Queries (Summary)

1. **DCO gate is hard:** `grep -A20 'check-dco:' .gitlab-ci.d/static_checks.yml` — confirm no `allow_failure` line.
2. **checkpatch is soft:** `grep -A15 'check-patch:' .gitlab-ci.d/static_checks.yml` — confirm `allow_failure: true` at line 13.
3. **Werror in all native builds:** `grep enable-werror .gitlab-ci.d/buildtest-template.yml` — line 12.
4. **GitHub is mirror-only:** `cat .github/workflows/lockdown.yml` — `close-pr: true`, `lock-pr: true`.
5. **Blame-ignore revs are style-only:** `git log --stat ad9e4585b3c7 0eadd56bf53a 8c7feddddd92 48805df9c22a` — confirm no semantic changes in those commits.
6. **Coccinelle count:** `ls scripts/coccinelle/*.cocci | wc -l` → `25`.
7. **QAPI generation test:** `grep custom_target tests/meson.build` — confirms generated file list is tracked and checked at build time.
8. **Fork CI opt-in:** `grep 'QEMU_CI' .gitlab-ci.d/base.yml` — lines 73–74 confirm forks receive no automatic pipeline without `QEMU_CI=1` or `QEMU_CI=2`.

The CI pipeline is defined in [`.gitlab-ci.d/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/qemu-project-qemu@300438ffbb8d9430cac2fcc15cba6f482b2c0587/-/tree/.gitlab-ci.d) and included from [`.gitlab-ci.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/qemu-project-qemu@300438ffbb8d9430cac2fcc15cba6f482b2c0587/-/blob/.gitlab-ci.yml) (which itself is a single-line include pointing to `qemu-project.yml`).

**Stages:** [`containers` → `build` → `test`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/qemu-project-qemu@300438ffbb8d9430cac2fcc15cba6f482b2c0587/-/blob/.gitlab-ci.d/stages.yml).

Key structural rules from [`.gitlab-ci.d/base.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/qemu-project-qemu@300438ffbb8d9430cac2fcc15cba6f482b2c0587/-/blob/.gitlab-ci.d/base.yml):
- Jobs **never** run automatically upstream on `stable-*` branches or tags (staging branches are used as pre-merge gates).
- Forks must opt-in by setting `QEMU_CI=1` (manual) or `QEMU_CI=2` (automatic).
- All native build jobs use `--enable-werror` (compiler warnings are build errors).
- `meson-logs/*.junit.xml` is collected as a JUnit test report artifact.

**Native build matrix** ([`buildtest.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/qemu-project-qemu@300438ffbb8d9430cac2fcc15cba6f482b2c0587/-/blob/.gitlab-ci.d/buildtest.yml)) includes at minimum: Alpine, Ubuntu 24.04, Debian. Each produces a `build` artifact used by downstream `check-*` and `functional-*` jobs.

**Cross-compilation builds** ([`crossbuilds.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/qemu-project-qemu@300438ffbb8d9430cac2fcc15cba6f482b2c0587/-/blob/.gitlab-ci.d/crossbuilds.yml)): arm64, ppc64el, riscv64, and others.

**Test targets invoked per job:**
- `check-unit` — unit tests
- `check-qtest` — QTest (device/integration tests via QEMU process)
- `check-functional` — functional tests (boots actual guest kernels)
- `check` — all of the above combined
- `check-build` — build-only, no test run (used in some jobs)

**Deterministic verification query:** In [`.gitlab-ci.d/buildtest-template.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/qemu-project-qemu@300438ffbb8d9430cac2fcc15cba6f482b2c0587/-/blob/.gitlab-ci.d/buildtest-template.yml?L12), confirm `--enable-werror` is passed unconditionally to `configure`.

#### 1.6 Rust-Specific Checks

A dedicated [`check-rust-tools-nightly`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/qemu-project-qemu@300438ffbb8d9430cac2fcc15cba6f482b2c0587/-/blob/.gitlab-ci.d/static_checks.yml?L50-68) job runs:
1. `cargo fmt --check` — format conformance.
2. `make clippy` — Rust linting.
3. `make rustdoc` — documentation build.

Clippy configuration is at [`clippy.toml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/qemu-project-qemu@300438ffbb8d9430cac2fcc15cba6f482b2c0587/-/blob/clippy.toml): MSRV is `1.83.0`; `allow-mixed-uninlined-format-args = false`; `doc-valid-idents` has project-specific overrides.

This job sets `allow_failure: true` (depends on `fedora-rust-nightly`, an unstable image).

**Deterministic verification query:** `clippy.toml` line 3: `msrv = "1.83.0"` is the pinned minimum Rust version for linting purposes.

#### 1.7 Python Tooling Checks

Two jobs in [`static_checks.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/qemu-project-qemu@300438ffbb8d9430cac2fcc15cba6f482b2c0587/-/blob/.gitlab-ci.d/static_checks.yml?L26-49):

- `check-python-tox` — runs `make -C python check-tox`; marked `QEMU_JOB_OPTIONAL: 1` (manual trigger in upstream, optional in forks).

#### 1.8 Compilation Unit Analysis

[`check-build-units`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/qemu-project-qemu@300438ffbb8d9430cac2fcc15cba6f482b2c0587/-/blob/.gitlab-ci.d/static_checks.yml?L74-95) runs [`.gitlab-ci.d/check-units.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/qemu-project-qemu@300438ffbb8d9430cac2fcc15cba6f482b2c0587/-/blob/.gitlab-ci.d/check-units.py) against `build/compile_commands.json` after a `configure` run. This reports total source file count, total build units, and the top 20 most-rebuilt files. This is an **informational/diagnostic** job (no enforced failure threshold).

#### 1.9 Coccinelle Semantic Patches

[`scripts/coccinelle/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/qemu-project-qemu@300438ffbb8d9430cac2fcc15cba6f482b2c0587/-/tree/scripts/coccinelle) contains 25 `.cocci` files for automated semantic analysis and refactoring, covering patterns such as:
- `errp-guard.cocci` — error pointer usage
- `error-use-after-free.cocci` — use-after-free in error paths
- `use-g_new-etc.cocci` — memory allocation idioms
- `timer-del-timer-free.cocci` — timer lifetime
- `overflow_muldiv64.cocci` — arithmetic overflow

These are not wired into a required CI job at this revision but serve as reviewer and developer tooling for tree-wide audits.

**Deterministic verification query:** `ls scripts/coccinelle/*.cocci | wc -l` in checkout → 25.

#### 1.10 `git blame` Ignore Revs

[`.git-blame-ignore-revs`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/qemu-project-qemu@300438ffbb8d9430cac2fcc15cba6f482b2c0587/-/blob/.git-blame-ignore-revs) lists 4 commits that were wholesale formatting/style cleanups:

These are style-only commits submitted as dedicated patches (consistent with the documented policy to separate style from semantic changes).

**Deterministic verification query:** `git log --oneline ad9e4585b3c7` and `git log --oneline 48805df9c22a` to confirm these are separate commits and not mixed with functional changes.

#### 1.11 Commit Message Conventions (Documented Policy)

From [`docs/devel/submitting-a-patch.rst`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/qemu-project-qemu@300438ffbb8d9430cac2fcc15cba6f482b2c0587/-/blob/docs/devel/submitting-a-patch.rst):
- **Format:** `subsystem: single line summary`; body max 76 chars/line.
- **`Fixes:` tag** (with `<12-digit SHA> ("subject")`) required when a commit corrects a prior commit in the repository.
- **`Resolves:` tag** for GitLab issue URLs (triggers automatic issue close on merge).
- **`Buglink:` tag** for external bug tracker references.
- **`Cc: qemu-stable@nongnu.org`** signals backport candidacy to stable branches.
- Other recognized tags: `Tested-by:`, `Acked-by:`, `Reported-by:`, `Suggested-by:`, `Message-Id:`.
- Each commit must be bisect-safe (compile and run successfully in isolation).

---

#### 1.12 Stable Branch / Backport Policy

- Release branches are named `stable-X.Y`; CI never runs jobs on these automatically upstream (see base.yml line 44).
- Backports flow: fix merged to `master` first, then cherry-picked to stable. Bug fixes for severe regressions should carry `Cc: qemu-stable@nongnu.org` to notify stable maintainers.
- Patchew integration points to `https://patchew.org/QEMU/` for per-patch status tracking.

#### 1.13 Test Directory Structure

[`tests/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/qemu-project-qemu@300438ffbb8d9430cac2fcc15cba6f482b2c0587/-/tree/tests) is subdivided by test class:

|-----------|---------|
| `tests/unit/` | Unit tests (C, fast, no QEMU process) |
| `tests/qtest/` | QTest — black-box device tests via QEMU process |
| `tests/functional/` | Functional tests — full guest boot scenarios |
| `tests/qapi-schema/` | Generated QAPI code output tests |
| `tests/tcg/` | TCG instruction translation tests |
| `tests/fp/` | Floating-point correctness tests |
| `tests/migration-stress/` | Migration-specific stress tests |
| `tests/docker/` | Docker-based build environment configs |
| `tests/lcitool/` | CI container build tooling |

QAPI generated file outputs are explicitly listed and verified in [`tests/meson.build`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/qemu-project-qemu@300438ffbb8d9430cac2fcc15cba6f482b2c0587/-/blob/tests/meson.build?L4-33) as a `custom_target`, ensuring generated code drifts are caught by build failures.

### 2. Summary of Gate Strictness

| Mechanism | Blocking? | Scope |
|---|---|---|
| `check-dco` (Signed-off-by) | **Yes** (hard fail) | All branches in forks and upstream staging |
| `check-patch` (checkpatch.pl) | No (`allow_failure: true`) | Fork branches only |
| `check-rust-tools-nightly` | No (`allow_failure: true`) | All |
| `check-python-minreqs` | **Yes** | All |
| `check-python-tox` | No (manual/optional) | All |
| `check-build-units` | No (informational) | All |
| Native build (`--enable-werror`) | **Yes** (compiler warnings are errors) | All build jobs |
| JUnit test reports | Collected always (`when: always`) | All meson test jobs |
| GitHub PRs | Immediately closed+locked | GitHub mirror |
